tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Quotient by a subcomplex as a mapping cone] ↗ def:cw-pair ↗ def:mapping-cone 1. ch0:0.13\group Homotopy Theory

For a CW pair $(X,A)$, the quotient $X/A$ is homotopy equivalent to the mapping cone $X\cup CA$ of $A\hookrightarrow X$, since $X/A=(X\cup CA)/CA$ and $CA$ is contractible. \end{example}
